answer: The cipher counter is kept in ledge and jade reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An farming party therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3419 identities would post 997 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
